note: Triennial election of councillors (two per ward; no aldermanic elections this year), polled on Wednesday 21 May 1958. The Larne Times nomination list names all six wards; after Matthew Gillespie withdrew in West Ward the only poll was in North Ward. Eden Ward had a single nominee for two seats and one councillorship there was left vacant. Three nominations (Matthew Gillespie, Armstrong, McCaughan); Gillespie withdrew, leaving the two unopposed (LT 15 May 1958 p6). Returned unopposed.
